hero.name: Srishti Pathak
hero.headline: B.Com Honours Student | Digital Marketing Learner | AI Automation Enthusiast
hero.bio: I'm currently pursuing B.Com Honours while learning Digital Marketing and AI Automation. I love exploring technology, creativity, and new ideas while building skills for my future career.

about.heading: About Me
about.subtitle: A little more about my journey, interests and goals
about.block1: I am currently pursuing B.Com Honours and exploring the world of Digital Marketing and AI Automation.
about.block2: I am interested in learning how digital platforms, marketing strategies and AI tools can be combined to create useful and creative solutions.
about.block3: Along with technology and marketing, I also enjoy creative activities such as playing guitar, art and craft.
about.block4: My current goal is to continuously improve my skills, gain practical experience and build a strong foundation for my future career in the digital world.

skills.heading: My Skills
skills.subtitle: Skills I'm learning, developing and exploring
skills.intro: I'm currently building my skills in Digital Marketing, AI, automation, content creation and creative technology. I'm focused on learning through practice and continuously improving my abilities.
skills.featuredDesc: My current focus is understanding how digital marketing and AI automation can work together to create smarter, more efficient digital workflows.

education.heading: My Education
education.subtitle: My academic journey and learning foundation
education.bcomDesc: Currently pursuing B.Com Honours and building a foundation in commerce, business and related subjects while developing additional digital skills.
education.beyondAcademicsText: Alongside my formal education, I am developing practical skills in Digital Marketing, AI Automation and creative areas such as Guitar, Art and Craft.

hobbies.heading: Hobbies & Interests
hobbies.subtitle: Creative activities that bring balance, inspiration and mindfulness
hobbies.guitarDesc: Playing acoustic guitar brings a sense of rhythm and mindfulness to my day. Learning chord transitions and melodies nurtures patience, focus, and a creative outlet alongside my studies.
hobbies.artDesc: Exploring watercolor painting and pencil sketching allows me to experiment with colors, textures, and visual compositions. This creative interest helps me develop an intuitive eye for design and aesthetics.
hobbies.craftDesc: Working on handmade crafts, paper art, and DIY projects sharpens my precision and attention to fine detail. Turning simple materials into thoughtful creations is both relaxing and creatively fulfilling.

contact.heading: Let's Connect
contact.subtitle: Have a project, idea, or simply want to get in touch? I'd love to hear from you.
contact.whatsappText: Hi Srishti! I saw your portfolio and would like to connect.
contact.ctaDesc: Whether you have a project idea, collaboration opportunity, or a question, feel free to send me a message.
